trap.label: ordem das palavras
trap.wrong: The key idea is trust, but I put it at the start: Trust is the key idea.
trap.right: The key idea is, above all, trust.
trap.why: Português admite a ideia-chave no início; em inglês a ênfase vai para o fim da oração e o sujeito deve ser o substantivo forte.

mcq.q: Where goes the key idea for emphasis?

opts: It is something that shapes contracts.
Trust is what we lack it.

mcq.q: Final word of the sentence receives…

fix.wrong: Trust it is what we lack.
There is a thing that shapes contracts, trust.
It exists trust in the group.

rewrite.prompt: Mova para o fim: “Trust is what we lack.”
Sujeito forte: “There is trust in every contract.”
